label: myadhd.my
caption:
Fine one minute, furious the next, then guilty for an hour.

Your feelings are not wrong, they just arrive at full volume. Swipe for why they skip the middle, and three ways to steady the swing.

If this sounded like your brain, come sit with people who get it. Our group is in my bio 👇

Save this for the next time you boil over.

#adhd #adhdmalaysia #myadhd #adhdadult #emotionalregulation

slides.title:
Why do my
feelings go
[[0 to 100]]?
slides.sub: You are not dramatic. Your feelings just arrive at full volume.

slides.title:
There is no
[[dimmer]], only
on and off
slides.body: Annoyed turns to furious. Excited turns to giddy. The feeling fits the moment. It just skips the middle settings everyone else seems to have.

slides.title:
It hits [[fast]],
before thinking
can catch up
slides.body: The reaction is out of your mouth before the pause arrives. By the time you have thought it through, you are already apologising for it.

slides.title:
Then comes
the [[second wave]]
slides.body: The shame afterwards often lasts longer than the feeling did. "Why am I like this?" weighs more than the snapped reply ever did.

slides.title:
It builds up
[[quietly]] first
slides.body: Most blow-ups are not about the last thing. They are about the hunger, the noise, the ten small things since morning. The last straw just gets the blame.

slides.title:
Name it, and
it [[shrinks]]
a little
slides.body: "I am overwhelmed" said out loud slows things down. Naming the feeling moves you from being inside it to looking at it.

slides.title:
Leave the room,
not the
[[conversation]]
slides.body: "Give me ten minutes, I want to come back to this." A short break with a promise to return is not running away. It keeps your words kind.

slides.title:
Check the
[[basics]] first
slides.body: Before deciding the whole day is ruined, ask the dull questions. Have I eaten? Slept? Had water? Big feelings get bigger on an empty tank.

slides.title:
Save this for the
next time you
[[boil over]]
slides.body: Your feelings are not too much. They just need more room to land. Dump everything into my.adhd and get one small thing back to steady you.
